name: fend
tagline: Type 1 ft to cm. The pad stays in this file. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Works offline. No account, no install, no website. Type a line, press Enter: 1 ft to cm, 5 kg in lb, 100 C to F. The last pad comes back the next time you open the app, because it lives in this file.

On a phone the keypad has digits and units so you can convert without a keyboard. A line that does not calculate says why. Variables stick: a = 3 then a * 2.

Unofficial port of fend by printfn. Same engine as their calculator. Their website is not in this app.
